post.caption: Schwarzenegger crawled for ruby beads. At the 1998 Oscars, Minnie Driver was nominated for Good Will Hunting and wore a bracelet of hundreds of ruby beads. It broke as she clapped for Robin Williams, and the beads scattered across the floor. James Cameron and Arnold Schwarzenegger got down on their hands and knees to find them. That same night Titanic won eleven Oscars. She told the story on The Tonight Show in March 2026: when she handed the pieces back, only four beads were missing.
